completeness_claim: Open-world metamodel candidate; enumeration saturation and independent review are not achieved.

gaps.description: No conformance-tested bidirectional mapping matrix yet exists across Arrow, Parquet, Avro, Protobuf, CBOR, JSON, XML, HDF5, NetCDF and Zarr.
gaps.closure_evidence: Property/conformance tests covering range, precision, null/absence, nested values and unknown extensions.

gaps.description: Locale collation, Unicode normalization, floating total order, decimal scale equality and URI/RDF canonicalization need separately versioned profiles and test vectors.
gaps.closure_evidence: Published executable law oracles and two independent implementations per profile.

gaps.description: Quantity kinds, code systems, observation roles and composite shapes from all industry packs have not been mapped and deduplicated against the horizontal core.
gaps.closure_evidence: All vertical packs map or emit typed extension gaps; two unrelated verticals exercise every extension mechanism.

gaps.description: The totality matrix is a first-pass owner/domain contract, not yet a full algebra of pre/postconditions, residuals, complexity and exact failure types for every overload.
gaps.closure_evidence: Each overload links to a deep operation record, law tests and provider qualification suite.

gaps.description: Loss-preserving mappings among RDF datasets, property multigraphs, temporal graphs and hypergraphs are incomplete.
gaps.closure_evidence: Explicit relation-level crosswalks with loss/refusal cases and round-trip fixtures.

gaps.description: Moving geometries, dynamic CRSs/coordinate epochs, topology-preserving precision reduction, meshes and coverages need deeper version and change laws.
gaps.closure_evidence: Standards-backed fixtures and independent CRS/topology conformance tests.

gaps.description: Codec/color/channel/time mappings cover representative standards but not the global modality and domain-format universe.
gaps.closure_evidence: Media/domain format inventory maps each supported representation to image/signal/timed-media shapes with declared loss.

gaps.description: Dependence structures, mixed/compound distributions, imprecise probability, censoring/truncation mechanisms and uncertainty propagation need deeper formal profiles.
gaps.closure_evidence: Method-specific propagation/censoring contracts with adversarial fixtures and reference comparisons.

gaps.description: Solver/simulator feature qualification, transformations, numerical tolerances, certificates, checkpoint portability and reproducibility guarantees are incomplete.
gaps.closure_evidence: Provider capability records plus model/solution/checkpoint conformance corpus across two independent implementations.

gaps.description: The horizontal model provides classification/purpose/retention hooks but intentionally does not adjudicate jurisdiction-specific law or anonymization sufficiency.
gaps.closure_evidence: Separate governed jurisdiction/vertical packs with legal owner, effective time and evidence; core remains law-neutral.

gaps.description: Volume/velocity/latency/locality axes are declared but performance envelopes and cost models are not yet linked to provider implementations.
gaps.closure_evidence: Parameterized benchmarks and provider offers keyed by shape/operation/workload profile.

gaps.description: No independent review, recurring freshness cycle or absence-of-new-category saturation study has been completed.
gaps.closure_evidence: Independent reviewers search disjoint standards/industries, adjudicate discoveries, and two consecutive cycles add no new core constructor/context.

gaps.description: Provider-specific mailbox identity, deduplication, threading, authentication evidence and export normalization need conformance fixtures beyond RFC/JMAP logical seeds.
gaps.closure_evidence: Round-trip and adversarial corpora across at least two independent mail stores plus authenticated-message evidence profiles.

gaps.description: PDF/office/HTML/EPUB logical order, layout, formulas, revisions, embedded objects, scripts, accessibility and extraction fidelity are seeded but not saturated.
gaps.closure_evidence: Format-profile conformance corpus compares bytes, logical structure, renderings and extracted views across independent implementations.

gaps.description: Language, ABI, build, package ecosystem, executable and configuration-consumer universes require separate governed extension packs.
gaps.closure_evidence: Language/ABI/package packs map to the core shapes and expose typed unsupported constructs without opaque semantic continuation.

gaps.description: Path traversal, link escape, duplicate members, expansion bombs, encryption, active content and external resource policies need executable law oracles.
gaps.closure_evidence: Adversarial safe-unpack/render fixtures and two independent bounded implementations for each supported compound profile.

gaps.description: Crosswalk records are evidence-backed candidates but do not yet have round-trip fixtures for every preservation and refusal claim.
gaps.closure_evidence: Every crosswalk links to positive, negative, boundary and lossy-round-trip conformance tests.

gaps.description: The explicit invalid-inference matrix is not yet compiled into all ingestion, conversion and analytical planning refusals.
gaps.closure_evidence: Compiler/evaluator tests demonstrate that each forbidden conclusion requires the listed additional evidence.

forbidden_shortcuts: Do not manufacture completeness by multiplying axis values.
Do not treat vendor format names as semantic type identity.
Do not infer grain, unit, key, time role, missing reason or authority from a field name.
Do not silently map unsupported meaning to text, number, JSON or opaque and continue analytical operations.
Do not claim a type/shape verified solely because a schema validates.
